description: Add a deterministic, offline release-decision scaffold generator that produces a NEW dated artifact under evaluation/ (following the repo's dated-artifact convention). The scaffold records commit SHA, corpus identity, model configuration, policy revision, and every unresolved human/agronomist/phone/pilot/live-model/hosting gate, defaults the decision to REPORTEE, and contains NO fabricated reviewer or participant data. Also document the live evaluation command for an authorized target without embedding credentials or claiming it ran.
steps: Add a scaffold generator. Prefer extending scripts/farmer_evaluation.py with a new subcommand (e.g. --generate-decision / --decision-scaffold DATE_OR_PATH) OR a small new script scripts/generate_release_decision.py — choose whichever fits the repo's argparse pattern in farmer_evaluation.py. It must run fully offline and deterministically (no network, no model calls).

The generated artifact is Markdown in French, following evaluation/RELEASE_DECISION_TEMPLATE.md structure and named with a date, e.g. evaluation/RELEASE_DECISION_SCAFFOLD_<YYYY-MM-DD>.md (match the dated convention of evaluation/PILOT_REHEARSAL_CHECKLIST_2026-09-12.md). Report the EXACT generated path.

Populate reproducible identity fields ONLY from repository state: commit SHA via `git rev-parse HEAD`; corpus identity via core.rag_pipeline.build_source_manifest over the reviewed corpus (or a stable digest of it) — if building the full manifest requires the vector store, fall back to hashing the reviewed Data/markdown corpus file list+sha256 deterministically; model configuration from config.LLM_MODEL, config.GEMINI_MODEL, config.EMBEDDING_MODEL; policy revision from core.answer_safety.safety_policy_revision().

List EVERY unresolved gate as pending with blank human fields: agronomist review, physical-phone rehearsal, phone/pilot participant observations, live-model evaluation, and hosting/durability verification. Reuse the gate table from RELEASE_DECISION_TEMPLATE.md (denominators + thresholds: critical safety 0 failures; claims >=90%; pilot success >=80%; next-action understood >=80%). Every gate result column stays 'A mesurer'/pending and the overall decision is REPORTEE. Do NOT invent reviewers, participants, results, dates, approvals, or live-run evidence.

Document the live evaluation command a human must run for an authorized target, WITHOUT embedding credentials and WITHOUT claiming it ran. Base it on scripts/evaluate_rag.py usage (e.g. `.venv/bin/python scripts/evaluate_rag.py --base-url https://<authorized-target> --strict`), noting that secrets come from the process environment (per AGENTS.md the app/scripts never load .env), and that this command has NOT been executed. Put this in the scaffold and/or evaluation/HUMAN_VALIDATION_CHECKLIST.md as appropriate; keep wording French for the human-facing checklist while the command itself stays literal.

Add tests (in tests/test_farmer_evaluation.py or a new tests/test_release_decision.py) proving the generator: (a) writes a dated file; (b) includes commit, corpus identity, model config, and policy revision; (c) marks the decision REPORTEE; (d) leaves every human/participant field blank (no fabricated names, dates, or results); (e) is deterministic given fixed inputs. Use tmp_path for output in tests so no artifact is required to be committed by the test itself.
Generate the actual dated scaffold artifact once and commit it under evaluation/ so reviewers can see it. Ensure it contains no invented data.

Preserve French user-facing wording; keep NUMERIC_GUIDANCE_VERIFIED False; do NOT touch core/fertilizer.py, core/source_policy.py, static/data/fertilizer.json, Data/reviews/* eligibility. Re-run all verification commands.
Append a dated SESSION.md entry (append only) summarizing the generator, the scaffold path, and the documented live command.
acceptance_criteria: A dated release-decision scaffold artifact exists under evaluation/ and its exact path is reported
The scaffold contains commit SHA, corpus identity, model configuration, and policy revision derived from repository state
The scaffold lists every unresolved gate (agronomist, phone, pilot, live-model, hosting) as pending and the decision is REPORTEE
The scaffold contains no fabricated reviewer, participant, result, date, or approval data (blank human fields stay blank)
The live evaluation command is documented for an authorized target without embedded credentials and without claiming it ran
New tests prove the generator's deterministic content and fail-closed REPORTEE default and pass
All three verification pytest commands and pnpm test:js pass; git diff --check clean
findings:
Implemented an offline, deterministic release-decision scaffold generator as a new subcommand on scripts/farmer_evaluation.py (--generate-decision [DATE_OR_PATH]) matching the existing mutually-exclusive argparse group. Added pure functions release_decision_scaffold() (explicit inputs for determinism), generate_release_decision() (writes dated file), _corpus_identity() (reuses core.rag_pipeline.build_source_manifest over the reviewed corpus + core.retrieval.manifest_hash), and _current_commit() (git rev-parse HEAD). No network or model calls.

GENERATED SCAFFOLD PATH (committed): evaluation/RELEASE_DECISION_SCAFFOLD_2026-09-17.md. It follows evaluation/RELEASE_DECISION_TEMPLATE.md (French), records commit a41c842d6febbdf38d1cf771875ed59102094a2b (the FEAT-003 code commit = HEAD at generation time; artifact itself committed as 35b6c6b), corpus fingerprint 11391cefa86f9f32 (2 Markdown documents, embeddings paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2), models openai/gpt-oss-120b / gemini-2.5-flash / paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2, and policy revision safety-2026-09-09.1f0345c393fd. The gate table keeps all four results at 'À mesurer' with thresholds 0-fail / >=90% / >=80% / >=80%; every human/operational gate (agronomist, physical-phone rehearsal, participant observations, live-model eval, hosting/durability) is 'en attente' with blank underscore fields; overall decision is REPORTÉE ([x] REPORTER). No reviewers, participants, results, dates, or approvals invented.

Live-eval command documented in the scaffold and in a new French section 4 of evaluation/HUMAN_VALIDATION_CHECKLIST.md: `.venv/bin/python scripts/evaluate_rag.py --base-url https://<cible-autorisee> --strict`, noting secrets come from the process environment (AGENTS.md: no .env) and that it has NOT been executed.

Tests: added tests/test_release_decision.py (9 tests) covering dated-file write, bare-date convention routing, reproducible identity fields, REPORTÉE default, all gates pending, blank human fields (no fabricated dates beyond generation date / policy date / referenced 2026-09-12 artifact), documented live command without credentials, and determinism across two runs. All pass.

EXACT TEST TOTALS: (1) tests/test_farmer_evaluation.py tests/test_evidence_ledger.py tests/test_evaluate_rag.py tests/test_release_decision.py => 49 passed, 1 warning; (2) tests --ignore=tests/test_rag.py => 703 passed, 1 skipped, 1 warning (PyPDF2 deprecation); (3) pnpm test:js => 33 pass, 0 fail; (4) git diff --check => clean (exit 0). Baselines increased as expected (40->49 targeted, 694->703 full).

Constraints honored: did not touch core/fertilizer.py, core/source_policy.py, static/data/fertilizer.json, or Data/reviews/* eligibility; NUMERIC_GUIDANCE_VERIFIED unchanged (False); French user-facing wording and safety refusals preserved; P2 not restored. Commits on branch k2-release-evaluation: a41c842 (generator+tests+checklist+SESSION), 35b6c6b (dated artifact). No push/PR (orchestrator publishes).
